answer: It was flagged because a worker overlapped the box of a truck for 15.0 s [E1]. The rule fires below 0.35 body-heights for at least 1 s. This is image-space proximity from an uncalibrated camera, not a measured distance or a collision prediction. Stress-test the event in IncidentLab to see how reliable the detections behind it are.
